name: comp-47
title: Card Number Input
description: A labelled card-number field with a credit-card icon inside its left edge. Typed digits are grouped into fours with spaces, and a grey placeholder sits there until the first keypress.
use: Checkout forms where card digits should be grouped as they are typed.
avoid: It handles only the number; expiry, security code and card type need separate fields.
a11y: The label is bound to the field and the icon is hidden from readers, but the credit link adds noise for assistive tech. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A label sits above a rounded dark field on black, with a small credit-card outline inside the left edge and a grey Card number placeholder. Typed digits run across the line in spaced groups of four, and a grey credit line sits below.
behaves: Focusing rings the field and typing auto-inserts spaces every four digits as the number grows. The clip enters 4242 4242 4242 4242 and the field holds the grouped spacing.
customise: The label and placeholder come from the payment library, while field and icon styling are classes in the file; the credit line is fixed.
weight: light: One field and a formatting helper; no animation or background work.
demo: Label Card Number, placeholder Card number, typed 4242 4242 4242 4242, plus a library credit line.
issues: A visible Built with React Payment Inputs credit link ships under the field.
The placeholder is spaced out so widely it reads more like a label than a hint.
polishWhy: Clean field and tidy digit grouping, but the credit link and spaced placeholder are rough.
